scalars.scalar_value: Demonstrated skill and experience driving a packer and/or front loader truck and/or large Class B commercial trucks safely and in tight, confined areas.

items.item_text: resume
cover letter
Position requires a Class B license to drive the trucks and vehicles.
Demonstrated skill and experience driving a packer and/or front loader truck and/or large Class B commercial trucks safely and in tight, confined areas.

In this position the Truck Driver performs recycle, organics, compost, and/or landfill collection duties following established practices and policies. The Truck Driver drives a rear loader packer truck, front loader truck, and other class B vehicles; and collects landfill, recyclables, organics, compost, or other materials on a specific route. The position loads and unloads landfill, recyclables, organics, compost, or other materials into/or from the truck, runs the controls on the truck, and stops to collect materials placed within receptacles or the replacing the receptacles themselves throughout the campus and/or along the specified route. The Truck Driver drives the truck to and from landfill, the transfer station, organics, compost or recycling facilities or other designated sites. The position performs safety and maintenance inspections of trucks daily and as needed.
Truck Collection and Transport - 60%

Drives a rear loader packer truck, front loader truck, or other class B vehicle and load and unloading of landfill, recyclables, organics, compost, or other materials from the trucks. Responsible for dumping trucks, collecting litter and empty receptacles, carts and dumpsters. Delivers and collects receptacles, carts, and dumpsters.
Operates loading, compacting and all other controls on trucks.
Vehicle Maintenance and Safety Inspection - 5%

Cleans and lubricates pivot points on truck bodies. Inspects components and fluid levels for cab chassis, body and motors. Checks stress points for wear. Checks air pressure in tires and tires for wear. Recognizes and immediately reports problems and service needs to the lead or supervisor.
Daily Safety Compliance - 5%

Conducts truck safety inspections on a daily basis as required by the California Highway Patrol BIT Program. The employee is personally responsible for following health and safety guidelines/instructions and using PPE (gloves, ear plugs, dust masks, hard toe shoes, hard hats, uniforms).
Records and Equipment Support - 5%

Keeps accurate records such as dump tag service requests, recharge numbers, work orders, and collection route lists. Paints, labels, repairs, and maintains receptacles, carts, and dumpsters and equipment as needed or directed. Performs other duties as assigned.
Must be able to read, write, and communicate in English.
Must maintain a valid CA DL and a clean DMV record.
Must be able to respond to emergencies, work overtime, weekends, events, and on holidays.
Must enroll in the DMV Pull-Notice Program
Knowledge and skill to perform vehicle maintenance and safety inspections.
Knowledge of principles of zero waste, recycling, organics, and composting (preferred).
Ability to work with minimum supervision.
Ability to interpret and follow verbal and written instructions.
Effective oral and written communication skills.
Ability to move up to 75-100 lbs. routinely.
Interpersonal skills and ability to work cooperatively with co-workers, clients, and the campus community.
Requires ability to work outdoors in fluctuating and/or extreme weather conditions.
